This eliminates white sidebars and gives a professional full-bleed look: ```python target_w, target_h = 1024, 1536 img = Image.open(input_path) scale_h = target_h / img.size[1] # e.g. 1536/1024 = 1.5 img_scaled = img.resize((int(img.size[0] * scale_h), target_h), Image.LANCZOS) x_offset = (img_scaled.size[0] - target_w) // 2 # center-crop width canvas = img_scaled.crop((x_offset, 0, x_offset + target_w, target_h)) ``` **When to use which:** Letterbox (black bars) when the art has important content at the very edges that shouldn't be cropped. {"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate all No Blue Sky covers — original art, best-selling sci-fi inspired style, correct typography."""
import base64, json, os, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
import requests
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageEnhance

OUTPUT_DIR = Path("/home/bob/books/publishing_output/covers")

# Get API key
result = subprocess.run(
    ["bash", "-c", "source ~/.hermes/.env && echo $GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_KEY"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
api_key = result.stdout.strip()

BOOKS = [
    {
        "num": 1,
        "title_words": ["BUILT", "FROM", "DUST"],
        "prompt": (
            "Book cover artwork for a sci-fi novel. A vast Martian colony under construction — "
            "half-finished geodesic domes rise from the red dust landscape. Massive construction cranes "
            "and machinery silhouette against a dusty orange sky. A tiny Earth hangs in the distance. "
            "Cinematic widescreen composition, dramatic lighting, sense of human endeavor against an alien world. "
            "Colors: deep Martian red, warm orange, silver metal, pale blue Earth. "
            "Leave the top 40% of the image as clean, empty negative space (dusty sky gradient) "
            "for title text placement. Leave the bottom 15% clean for author name. "
            "CRITICAL: No text, no watermarks, no letters, no logos anywhere. "
            "Inspired by best-selling sci-fi cover aesthetics but completely original — no copied elements."
        )
    },
    {
        "num": 2,
        "title_words": ["THE", "OXYGEN", "GAMBLE"],
        "prompt": (
            "Book cover artwork for a sci-fi novel. A massive oxygen processing facility on Mars — "
            "towering silver tanks and intricate pipe networks stretch across the red landscape. "
            "Vapor clouds vent from pressure valves, catching the harsh sunlight. A dark dust storm "
            "looms on the horizon. High contrast, dramatic industrial sci-fi. "
            "Colors: silver metal, rust red, white vapor clouds, deep storm-darkened sky. "
            "Leave the top 40% of the image as clean, empty negative space (storm sky gradient) "
            "for title text placement. Leave the bottom 15% clean for author name. "
            "CRITICAL: No text, no watermarks, no letters, no logos anywhere. "
            "Inspired by best-selling sci-fi cover aesthetics but completely original — no copied elements."
        )
    },
    {
        "num": 3,
        "title_words": ["RIVERS", "UNDER", "MARS"],
        "prompt": (
            "Book cover artwork for a sci-fi novel. A vast underground cavern beneath Mars — "
            "crystal-clear blue water rivers winding through ancient rock, illuminated by bioluminescent "
            "algae and mining lights. A small drilling platform stands on a rock outcropping above the water. "
            "The cavern ceiling glitters with mineral deposits. Magical, discovery-filled atmosphere. "
            "Colors: luminous aqua blue, warm amber lights, dark basalt rock, silver equipment. "
            "Leave the top 40% of the image as clean, empty negative space (dark cavern ceiling gradient) "
            "for title text placement. Leave the bottom 15% clean for author name. "
            "CRITICAL: No text, no watermarks, no letters, no logos anywhere. "
            "Inspired by best-selling sci-fi cover aesthetics but completely original — no copied elements."
        )
    },
    {
        "num": 4,
        "title_words": ["RED", "CHARTER"],
        "prompt": (
            "Book cover artwork for a sci-fi novel. The grand government plaza of a Martian colony — "
            "a sweeping curved building with tall columns under a massive transparent dome. A red flag "
            "with a geometric symbol flies prominently. Colonists in practical Mars suits gather in the "
            "square below. Warm golden sunset light filters through the dome. Political, aspirational, grand. "
            "Colors: Martian red, warm gold, silver dome framework, deep indigo sky beyond the dome. "
            "Leave the top 40% of the image as clean, empty negative space (dome ceiling gradient) "
            "for title text placement. Leave the bottom 15% clean for author name. "
            "CRITICAL: No text, no watermarks, no letters, no logos anywhere. "

            "In the foreground, a large Martian flag (red with a silver planetary symbol) waves on a pole. "

            "Colors: bright red, warm gold, silver, orange sunset, deep space black with scattered faint stars. "
            "Leave the top 40% of the image as clean, empty negative space (sky gradient) "
            "for title text placement. Leave the bottom 15% clean for author name. "
            "CRITICAL: No text, no watermarks, no letters, no logos anywhere. "
            "Inspired by best-selling sci-fi cover aesthetics but completely original — no copied elements."
        )
    }
]

def generate_artwork(book):
    """Generate artwork for one book."""
    raw_out = str(OUTPUT_DIR / f"NBS_{book['num']}_Built_from_Dust_raw.png" if book['num'] == 1 else 
                  OUTPUT_DIR / f"NBS_{book['num']}_{'_'.join(book['title_words'])}_raw.png")
    
    # Fix book 1 naming
    if book['num'] == 1:
        raw_out = str(OUTPUT_DIR / "NBS_1_Built_from_Dust_raw.png")
    elif book['num'] == 2:
        raw_out = str(OUTPUT_DIR / "NBS_2_Oxygen_Gamble_raw.png")
    elif book['num'] == 3:
        raw_out = str(OUTPUT_DIR / "NBS_3_Rivers_Under_Mars_raw.png")
    elif book['num'] == 4:
        raw_out = str(OUTPUT_DIR / "NBS_4_Red_Charter_raw.png")
    elif book['num'] == 5:
        raw_out = str(OUTPUT_DIR / "NBS_5_First_Martian_Nation_raw.png")
    
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Generating: {' '.join(book['title_words'])} (Book {book['num']})")
    
    url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash-image:generateContent?key={api_key}"
    payload = {
        "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": book['prompt']}]}],
        "generationConfig": {"temperature": 1.0}
    }
    
    resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=120)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    
    candidate = data.get('candidates', [{}])[0]
    parts = candidate.get('content', {}).get('parts', [])
    
    for part in parts:
        if isinstance(part, dict) and 'inlineData' in part:
            img_bytes = base64.b64decode(part['inlineData']['data'])
            with open(raw_out, "wb") as f:
                f.write(img_bytes)
            print(f"  ✅ Saved raw: {Path(raw_out).name} ({len(img_bytes)//1024}KB)")
            return raw_out
    
    print(f"  ❌ No image data in response")
    print(f"  DEBUG: {json.dumps(data, indent=2)[:300]}")
    return None

def apply_typography(book, raw_path):
    """Apply typography overlay to create final cover."""
    if not raw_path or not os.path.exists(raw_path):
        print(f"  ❌ Raw file missing: {raw_path}")
        return
    
    target_w, target_h = 1200, 1800
    
    # Map raw to final output
    name_map = {
        1: "NBS_1_Built_from_Dust_Cover.png",
        2: "NBS_2_Oxygen_Gamble_Cover.png",
        3: "NBS_3_Rivers_Under_Mars_Cover.png",
        4: "NBS_4_Red_Charter_Cover.png",
        5: "NBS_5_First_Martian_Nation_Cover.png",
    }
    final_out = str(OUTPUT_DIR / name_map[book['num']])
    
    print(f"  Applying typography to {Path(raw_path).name}...")
    
    img = Image.open(raw_path).convert("RGBA")
    w, h = img.size
    
    # Scale to portrait
    scale = target_h / h
    new_w = int(w * scale)
    img = img.resize((new_w, target_h), Image.LANCZOS)
    
    if new_w > target_w:
        xo = (new_w - target_w) // 2
        img = img.crop((xo, 0, xo + target_w, target_h))
    else:
        canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (target_w, target_h), (0, 0, 0, 255))
        canvas.paste(img, ((target_w - new_w) // 2, 0))
        img = canvas
    
    # Brighten & contrast
    img = ImageEnhance.Brightness(img).enhance(1.20)
    img = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img).enhance(1.1)
    
    # Gradient overlay
    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (target_w, target_h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    dover = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
    
    for y in range(int(target_h * 0.30)):
        a = int(120 * (1 - y / (target_h * 0.30)))
        dover.rectangle([0, y, target_w, y+1], fill=(0, 0, 0, min(a, 90)))
    for y in range(int(target_h * 0.15)):
        a = int(100 * (y / (target_h * 0.15)))
        dover.rectangle([0, target_h - int(target_h * 0.15) + y, target_w, target_h - int(target_h * 0.15) + y + 1],
                       fill=(0, 0, 0, min(a, 80)))
    
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, overlay).convert("RGB")
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    font_path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
    
    # --- TITLE (stacked words) ---
    title_words = book['title_words']
    
    # Find largest font that fits the widest word within 80% of cover width
    for test_size in range(300, 40, -2):
        font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, test_size)
        max_w = max(draw.textbbox((0, 0), w, font=font)[2] - draw.textbbox((0, 0), w, font=font)[0] for w in title_words)
        if max_w <= int(target_w * 0.80):
            title_font_size = test_size
            break
    else:
        title_font_size = 40
    
    title_font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, title_font_size)
    
    # Calculate line dimensions
    line_hs = []
    line_ws = []
    for word in title_words:
        bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), word, font=title_font)
        line_ws.append(bb[2] - bb[0])
        line_hs.append(bb[3] - bb[1])
    
    line_gap = int(title_font_size * 0.12)
    total_stack_h = sum(line_hs) + line_gap * (len(title_words) - 1)
    
    # Center stacked title vertically in top 35% of cover
    title_zone_h = int(target_h * 0.35)
    start_y = (title_zone_h - total_stack_h) // 2 + int(target_h * 0.02)
    
    current_y = start_y
    for i, word in enumerate(title_words):
        x = (target_w - line_ws[i]) // 2
        for ox, oy in [(3, 3), (2, 2), (1, 1)]:
            draw.text((x+ox, current_y+oy), word, font=title_font, fill=(0, 0, 0, 180))
        draw.text((x, current_y), word, font=title_font, fill=(255, 255, 255, 255))
        current_y += line_hs[i] + line_gap
    
    max_word_pct = max(line_ws) / target_w * 100
    print(f"    Title: {' | '.join(title_words)} at {title_font_size}px ({max_word_pct:.0f}% widest)")
    
    # --- SERIES ---
    sf = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 18)
    st = f"NO BLUE SKY  •  BOOK {book['num']}"
    sb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), st, font=sf)
    sx = (target_w - (sb[2] - sb[0])) // 2
    draw.text((sx+1, 9+1), st, font=sf, fill=(0, 0, 0, 160))
    draw.text((sx, 9), st, font=sf, fill=(200, 200, 200, 255))
    
    # --- AUTHOR ---
    author_text = "Bob J Mills"
    af = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 100)
    ab = draw.textbbox((0, 0), author_text, font=af)
    aw = ab[2] - ab[0]
    ax = (target_w - aw) // 2
    ay = target_h - int(target_h * 0.07)
    
    bar_h = int(target_h * 0.09)
    draw.rectangle([0, target_h - bar_h - 5, target_w, target_h], fill=(0, 0, 0, 160))
    for ox, oy in [(2, 2), (1, 1)]:
        draw.text((ax+ox, ay+oy), author_text, font=af, fill=(0, 0, 0, 180))
    draw.text((ax, ay), author_text, font=af, fill=(255, 255, 255, 255))
    print(f"    Author: {author_text} at 100px ({aw}px)")
    
    img.save(final_out, quality=95)
    print(f"  ✅ Saved final: {Path(final_out).name}")
    return final_out

# === MAIN ===
print("="*60)
print("REGENERATING ALL NO BLUE SKY COVERS")
print("="*60)

for book in BOOKS:
    raw = generate_artwork(book)
    if raw:
        time.sleep(3)  # Rate limit between generations
        apply_typography(book, raw)
    else:
        print(f"  ⏭ Skipping typography for Book {book['num']} (no raw image)")

print("\n" + "="*60)
print("✅ ALL NO BLUE SKY COVERS COMPLETE")
print("="*60)

Alternative to letterbox (black bars) for book covers where you want the artwork to show through behind the text. Uses gradient darkening at top/bottom + shadowed white text.

## When to Use

- The AI-generated image has good art across the full canvas (no need for letterbox bars)
- Bright elements near the top or bottom need subtle darkening for text legibility
- You want a professional "text-over-artwork" look rather than black bars
- Title should be ~80% of cover width, bold, centered

## Technique

### Step 1: Add gradient overlays

```python
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageEnhance, ImageFont

img = Image.open(raw_path).convert("RGBA")
w, h = img.size

overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
draw_overlay = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)

# Top gradient for title zone (darker, ~35% of height)
grad_height_top = int(h * 0.35)
for y in range(grad_height_top):
    alpha = int(180 * (1 - y / grad_height_top))
    draw_overlay.rectangle([0, y, w, y+1], fill=(0, 0, 0, min(alpha, 140)))

# Bottom gradient for author zone (~15% of height)
grad_height_bot = int(h * 0.15)
for y in range(grad_height_bot):
    alpha = int(140 * (y / grad_height_bot))
    draw_overlay.rectangle([0, h - grad_height_bot + y, w, h - grad_height_bot + y + 1], 
                          fill=(0, 0, 0, min(alpha, 100)))

img = Image.alpha_composite(img, overlay).convert("RGB")
```

### Step 2: Add shadowed typography

```python
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Title font sizing: scale to ~80% of cover width
font_size = 60
font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", font_size)

# Get max line width and scale
lines = title_text.split('\n')  # e.g. ["THE", "OXYGEN", "GAMBLE"]
max_line_w = max(draw.textbbox((0,0), l, font=font)[2] - draw.textbbox((0,0), l, font=font)[0] for l in lines)
target_w_px = int(w * 0.8)
scale = target_w_px / max_line_w if max_line_w > 0 else 1
adjusted_size = max(40, min(90, int(font_size * scale)))
title_font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, adjusted_size)

# Draw centered stacked title
title_y = int(h * 0.03)
for line in lines:
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), line, font=title_font)
    lw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    lh = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    x = (w - lw) // 2
    
    # Shadow for legibility over art
    draw.text((x+2, title_y+2), line, font=title_font, fill=(0,0,0,180))
    draw.text((x, title_y), line, font=title_font, fill=(255,255,255,255))
    
    title_y += lh + 5

# Author name at bottom with dark box
author_text = "Bob J Mills"
author_font_size = 32
author_font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, author_font_size)
ab = draw.textbbox((0, 0), author_text, font=author_font)
ax = (w - (ab[2] - ab[0])) // 2
ay = h - int(h * 0.08)
box_h = int(h * 0.08)
draw.rectangle([0, h - box_h - 10, w, h], fill=(0, 0, 0, 160))
draw.text((ax+2, ay+2), author_text, font=author_font, fill=(0,0,0,180))
draw.text((ax, ay), author_text, font=author_font, fill=(255,255,255,255))
```

### Step 3: Series branding line

Add a small series + book number line at the very top:

```python
sub_font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 16)
series_text = "The Lunar Foundation  •  Book 2"
sb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), series_text, font=sub_font)
sub_x = (w - (sb[2] - sb[0])) // 2
sub_y = int(h * 0.01)
draw.text((sub_x+1, sub_y+1), series_text, font=sub_font, fill=(0,0,0,160))
draw.text((sub_x, sub_y), series_text, font=sub_font, fill=(200,200,200,255))
```

## Comparison with Letterbox Approach

| Factor | Gradient Overlay | Letterbox (Black Bars) |
|--------|-----------------|----------------------|
| Artwork visibility | Art shows through behind text | Art completely hidden under bars |
| Text legibility | Good but varies with art brightness | Excellent (pure black behind white text) |
| Professional look | Modern, integrated | Clean, traditional cover |
| Best for | Dark/moody artwork with good contrast | Bright/busy artwork |
| Shadow needed | 2px shadow essential | 1px shadow sufficient |

## Critical Rules for All Covers
